description: Compare two CSV files by a KEY column, of ANY size: which rows are only in A, only in B, and which changed and in WHICH columns. Columns are matched by header name, so a re-exported file with reordered columns or rows is not "everything changed" (it is for a line diff). Both files are streamed from disk; only the keys of B are held in memory, so do not read them into your context — pass the paths. Quoted cells with commas or line breaks inside are handled (RFC 4180). Optionally writes the FULL difference, one row per changed cell (`estado,clave,columna,valor_a,valor_b`), to `outPath`.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter (default: detected, e.g. "," ";" or tab)

header.description: Both files have a header row

key.description: Key column: its header name, or its 1-based position if there is no header

keyB.description: Key column in B, if named differently

outPath.description: Write the full long-format difference here (CSV)

pathA.description: First CSV (the reference, e.g. yesterday's export)

name: csv_diff
